Text is centered horizontally. No all-caps, no italics, no bullet markers. Line spacing is generous between the three title lines.

recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with a white background (#FFFFFF). 2. Draw a rectangle spanning approx. 5%-95% width and 8%-95% height; fill it with very light gray (#E9E9E9) and give it a thin (1pt) dark-red (#B22222) outline, square corners, no shadow. 3. Insert a centered text box inside the rectangle, vertically positioned so its block sits between ~33% and ~68% of slide height. 4. Type three centered lines: '[2] Machine Learning' (bold serif, ~44pt, #B22222), 'vs' (bold serif, ~16pt, #B22222), 'Deep Learning' (bold serif, ~44pt, #B22222). Use a Times New Roman/Georgia-style serif font, generous paragraph spacing between lines. 5. Optionally add a small white pen/cursor icon overlapping the top of 'Deep Learning' only if replicating the video frame exactly; otherwise omit it as a recording artifact. 6. Do not add bullets, footers, slide numbers, or charts. 7. (Optional, for frame fidelity only) add a solid black rectangle across the full bottom edge (~5% height) to mimic the captured video control bar; omit for a clean slide.
